The SVG path contains two arc commands (A) with identical radii (3.66,3.66), forming a closed shape. Since both arcs have the same radius and sweep flags, they trace two complementary arcs of the same ellipse, forming a full ellipse rather than a circle (because the radii are equal but not necessarily circular—though here they are numerically equal, the presence of two arcs suggests an elliptical path).  

Looking at the options, "ellipse" is explicitly listed as (K), which matches this interpretation.  

Final answer: (K)
